name: Projects
summary: Projects, sections and tasks for a team, with owners, collaborators, checklists and a board.

dataHandling.purpose: Planning and tracking a team's work
dataHandling.retention: As long as the organization keeps its projects

changelog: Adds the Projects screens (My Work, projects, the board and list, the task drawer), task attachments, and task counts on projects and sections. Upgrading from 1.0.0: the new unfreeze_on_reopen trigger lands disarmed, so arm it alone with app-package arm --package rfx/projects --only trigger:unfreeze_on_reopen. The task counts are rollups, and while Project and Section carry a rollup, any of your own field-enforcing workflow or agent steps that reads a Project or Section record sees it as Unknown and takes its default branch, with no error.

parameters.label: Project users
parameters.help: Everyone who uses Projects. Give its members a role with entity.read, entity.list, entity.write and entity.delete: a role does not come from a group. Which projects and tasks each person reaches is decided per project, by its managers and members.

parameters.label: Project creators
parameters.help: The people who may create projects. A new project's creator becomes its first manager.

parameters.label: Automation principal
parameters.help: The service principal the app's workflows run as: stamping a task's completion, and freezing a closed project's tasks. Give it a role with entity.read, entity.list and entity.write, add it to the automation group, and issue it no credential.

parameters.label: Automation group
parameters.help: A group holding the automation principal and one dedicated account that never signs in (setup needs at least one person in a group). Its members may change any task, including a frozen one, so add no one else.

parameters.label: Project admins
parameters.help: The people who oversee every project: they see all projects, sections, tasks and status updates, change or delete any project, and manage task labels. Give them the same role as Project users.
